title: 第7章 推演功法第8章 差个炼丹炉
slug: 为了长生不死我带着全宗修仙
content_zh:
;;
一个时辰后。
“不行了，我不行了，我要成人干了。这玩意儿也太奇葩了吧！”
寂月感觉自己像是被妖精吸干了精气一样，她真的一滴都没有了。
不过好在这个时候吸收停了下来，应该是吸饱了灵气，那棵树发出微弱的动静。
一个洞口出现，就在树干中间。
“人干事？”
这谁能想得到？
这片林子是非常普通的一个林子，这里面最高修为的妖兽估计也只有炼气期九层，不到大圆满的那种。
结果这里面居然藏了这么奇葩的一个洞府？
是不是因为她逼格不够高，所以才这样的？
要不要找个风水宝地跳崖，说不定还能在崖底获得高人的传承。
胡思乱想一通后，寂月休息了一会儿，感觉体内灵气逐渐充盈起来，这才往洞口里钻。
说是洞府，其实就是个地窖。
里面的空间不是很大，摆着一副骷髅架子，旁边是几个空了的瓷瓶。
从骷髅上的痕迹来看，应该是受过很严重的伤，估计是到了治不了的地步，所以才被迫留下传承。
指骨上有一枚空间戒指，戒指里应该有寂月想要的东西。
“前辈，冒昧打扰，是晚辈之过错。晚辈需要一枚洗髓丹，为晚辈的徒弟逆天改命，还望前辈海涵。”
她深吸一口气，上前取出了空间戒指。
主人身死，空间戒指也没了禁制，很容易就能探进去，把里面的东西拿出来。

除了一些丹药，还有一本关于炼丹的入门功法，一本关于炼体的功法。
最重要的洗髓丹只有一颗，并且还保留着药效。
其实这都算不上传承，寂月顶多算是捡尸。
但好歹是承了对方的人情，所以她挖了个坑，把骷髅埋了进去。
也算是入土为安。
寂月出来还不到一天时间。
想了想，她最后盘腿坐下，打开了那两本功法。
她的灵根比较杂，说明她可以走很多路。
炼丹，炼器，她都可以。
但问题在于，功法。
不怕，她有系统，
【检测到炼丹师入门功法，正在推演……
推演成功。

An hour later.
"I can't do it anymore, I can't do it anymore, I want to be an adult. This thing is too weird!"
Jiyue felt like she had been sucked dry by a goblin. She really didn't have a drop left.
Fortunately, the absorption stopped at this time. It must have been full of spiritual energy, and the tree made a faint movement.
A hole appeared, right in the middle of the tree trunk.
"Man-in-charge?"
Who could have imagined this?
This forest is a very ordinary forest. The monsters with the highest level of cultivation here are probably only at the ninth level of the Qi Refining Stage, not the level of Dzogchen.
As a result, there is such a weird cave hidden inside?
Is it because she is not qualified enough that she is like this?
How about finding a feng shui treasured place to jump off a cliff? Maybe you can get the inheritance of an expert at the bottom of the cliff.
After thinking wildly, Jiyue rested for a while, feeling that the spiritual energy in her body was gradually filling up, and then she crawled into the hole.
It is said to be a cave, but it is actually a cellar.
The space inside is not very big, with a skeleton shelf and several empty porcelain bottles next to it.
Judging from the marks on the skull, he must have been seriously injured, probably to the point of being unable to be cured, so he was forced to leave a legacy.
There is a space ring on the finger bone, and there should be something Jiyue wants in the ring.
"Senior, it's junior's fault for disturbing me. I need a marrow-cleansing pill to change the destiny of my apprentice. I hope senior will forgive me."
She took a deep breath and stepped forward to take out the space ring.
After the owner dies, the space ring is no longer restricted, and it is easy to reach in and take out the things inside.
In addition to some elixirs, there is also an introductory book on elixir refining and a book on body training.
The most important marrow-cleansing pill only has one, and it still retains its medicinal effect.
In fact, this is not even considered inheritance. Jiyue is at best picking up corpses.
But at least she accepted the favor, so she dug a hole and buried the skeleton in it.
It can also be regarded as resting in peace.
Jiyue has been out for less than a day.
After thinking for a while, she finally sat down cross-legged and opened the two books of exercises.
Her spiritual roots are relatively complex, which means she can walk many paths.
She can do both alchemy and weapon refining.
But the problem is, the technique.
Don't be afraid, she has a system,
[The alchemist's introductory skills have been detected and are being deduced...
The deduction was successful.
